modules: 首位用户与任务楔子
只选一位真实用户和一个高频任务族，记录当前替代工具、每周发生次数、人工分钟、最容易出错的环节和可接受的外部风险。示例可以用“独立研究者整理多份资料并产出带引用的报告”，但必须由真实工作记录证明。
真实任务证据包
建立 fixtures/tasks，每条任务固定输入、目标产物、验收方式、失败样本、风险级别和任务类别。20–30 个候选中至少保留 12 个，并覆盖研究、文档、代码、邮件、日程、网页、数据和桌面八类中的主要类别。
双基线实验
对同一批任务分别跑全人工和直接使用 Codex，使用同一验收器记录人工分钟、成功率、Token/成本、错误类型、返工次数和用户不满点。不要用不同任务或不同标准证明 Hearth 更好。
价值与停止判断
写一页产品定义，说明 Hearth 相比直接使用 Codex 多提供了哪一层：持久状态、审批、恢复、审计、产物验证或长期上下文。同时写明非目标、成功指标和继续/停止条件，防止后续用“功能更多”代替真实价值。
First user and task wedge

Choose one real user and one high-frequency task family. Record current alternatives, weekly frequency, manual minutes, error-prone steps, and acceptable external risk. Independent research reporting is a valid example only when real work records substantiate it.
Real-task evidence pack

Create fixtures/tasks with fixed inputs, expected artifacts, acceptance rules, failure samples, risk level, and task family. Keep at least 12 of 20–30 candidates and cover the major families: research, documents, code, email, calendar, web, data, and desktop.
Dual-baseline experiment

Run the same tasks manually and with direct Codex. Capture manual minutes, success rate, Token/cost, failure classes, rework, and user complaints with the same validator; never compare different tasks or standards.
Value and stop decision

Write a one-page product definition stating what Hearth adds beyond direct Codex: durable state, approvals, recovery, audit, artifact validation, or long-term context. Record non-goals, success metrics, and kill criteria so more features cannot substitute for real value.
四个入口与信息架构
今日展示正在运行和最近完成；需要你只放审批、补充信息和接管；产物按任务聚合可预览文件；设置承载工作区、连接和通知。用户进入后先看到“现在需要做什么”，而不是系统能力清单。
七种状态与唯一主动作
为排队、执行、等待审批、需要信息、完成、失败、可恢复分别定义原因、下一步和一个主按钮。取消、重试、查看原始事件等次要动作收进详情，避免同一状态出现多个互相竞争的主按钮。
完整任务剧本
用接近真实的数据串起创建任务、看到计划与进度、处理审批或补充信息、打开产物、制造一次失败、选择恢复的完整路径。原型必须包含至少一个无法自动恢复、需要转人工的路径。
可用性走查与投影映射
让首位用户不看说明完成任务，记录首次成功时间、犹豫点和错误点击；同时维护“状态—主动作—projection 字段”映射表，原型里每个可见字段都必须能指向真实契约。
Four entries and information architecture

Today shows running and recently completed work; Needs you contains approvals, missing information, and takeovers; Artifacts groups previewable files by task; Settings holds workspaces, connections, and notifications. Users first see what needs action, not a capability inventory.
Seven states and one primary action

Define reason, next step, and one primary button for queued, running, waiting for approval, needs information, completed, failed, and recoverable. Move cancel, retry, and raw events into details so one state does not present competing primary actions.
Complete task script

Use realistic data to connect task creation, plan and progress, approval or missing information, artifact opening, a deliberate failure, and recovery. Include at least one path that cannot recover automatically and must hand over to a human.
Usability review and projection map

Ask the first user to complete the path without instructions; record time to first success, hesitation, and misclicks. Maintain a state-to-primary-action-to-projection map so every visible field points to a real contract.
领域实体与不变量
定义 Source、Event、Thread、Intent、Task、Ticket、Mandate、Policy、Assignment、Run、Executor、Approval、Artifact、Receipt、Budget 的字段、关系和不可破坏条件。例如同一 Ticket 最多一个有效 Assignment，Artifact 内容寻址，Receipt 必须绑定幂等键。
事件、状态机与投影
把创建、排队、执行、审批、失败、恢复和完成写成显式事件；任务卡、收件箱、产物和成本都由投影生成。未知事件或未知状态只能进入“需要处理”，不能推断为成功。
持久执行接口
固定 Event Log、outbox、lease、fencing token、schema migration 和 SSE 的边界。规定先落盘再执行、外部副作用先写 intent、重试复用幂等键，以及崩溃后如何安全重投。
Mock server 与契约测试
mock server 只消费同一事件流来驱动原型；为主路径、审批拒绝、未知状态、重复事件和恢复编写契约测试。schema 使用版本号，旧事件重放不能产生外部副作用。
Domain entities and invariants

Define fields, relationships, and invariants for Source, Event, Thread, Intent, Task, Ticket, Mandate, Policy, Assignment, Run, Executor, Approval, Artifact, Receipt, and Budget. For example, a Ticket has at most one active Assignment, artifacts are content-addressed, and receipts bind an idempotency key.
Events, state machines, and projections

Emit explicit events for creation, queueing, execution, approval, failure, recovery, and completion. Rebuild task cards, inbox, artifacts, and cost from projections. Unknown events or states can only become Needs attention, never success.
Durable execution interfaces

Fix boundaries for Event Log, outbox, lease, fencing token, schema migration, and SSE. Persist before execution, write effect intent before side effects, reuse idempotency keys on retry, and define safe redelivery after a crash.
Mock server and contract tests

The mock server drives the prototype from the same event stream. Cover the main path, rejected approval, unknown state, duplicate event, and recovery with contract tests. Version schemas; replay must not trigger external side effects.
12 任务评测 runner
评测器读取任务包，执行基线或候选实现，按产物结构、事实依据、格式、人工复核和成本评分。记录失败分类和可恢复性；同一任务、同一评分器才能横向比较。
威胁模型与审批矩阵
列出资产、攻击面、信任边界和最坏后果，至少覆盖提示词注入、越权工具调用、秘密泄露、重复副作用和伪造完成。按风险等级定义审批、Effect Preview、禁止动作和人工接管。
工程骨架与 CI
建立 monorepo、lint、类型检查、单元/契约/集成测试、ADR 模板和文档目录。CI 至少拦住 schema 回归、契约破坏、危险动作无审批、迁移不兼容和未登记状态。
Fake executor 与观测字段
fake executor 驱动没有真实副作用的完整 UI 流程，并能注入超时、失败、未知状态和恢复。统一定义 trace、Token、成本、延迟、人工分钟、打断次数和失败类型字段，后续阶段不得另建口径。
12-task evaluation runner

The runner loads task packs, executes a baseline or candidate, and scores artifact structure, evidence, format, manual review, and cost. Record failure class and recoverability; only like-for-like tasks and scorers are comparable.
Threat model and approval matrix

List assets, attack surfaces, trust boundaries, and worst outcomes, covering prompt injection, unauthorized tool use, secret leakage, duplicate effects, and fabricated completion. Map risk levels to approval, Effect Preview, prohibited actions, and human takeover.
Engineering skeleton and CI

Create the monorepo, lint, type checks, unit/contract/integration tests, ADR template, and documentation directories. CI blocks schema regressions, broken contracts, unapproved dangerous actions, incompatible migrations, and unregistered states.
Fake executor and observability fields

The fake executor drives the full UI without real side effects and can inject timeout, failure, unknown state, and recovery. Define trace, Token, cost, latency, manual minutes, interruptions, and failure class once so later stages reuse the same measures.
